newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulf sees major 1996 reserve replacement.
newsitem.headline: Gulf sees major 1996 reserve replacement.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that it was on target to replace 300 percent of its production in 1996 with gross proved reserves.

Gulf, which earlier reported-third quarter earnings per share of nil, versus a loss of C$0.02 in the same period last year, said its reserve replacement forecast included 85 million barrels of oil equivalent booked in Indonesia.
In the first nine months of this year, the company participated in 475 wells, including "a number of big hit" opportunities, it said.
Gulf also said it expected to realize proceeds from asset sales of about C$160 million in the fourth quarter and about $235 million for the full year.

It said it took advantage of a strong market to sell more assets than originally anticipated and expects to reinvest the additional proceeds in "opportunities to add new volumes and maintain growth in 1997," it said.
